problem:
A series RCL circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $12\,\text{V},$ a resistance of $40\,Ω,$ a capacitance of $0.005\,\text{F},$ and an inductance of $L=20\,\text{H}.$ Find the differential equation governing the amount of current $I$ (in amperes) in the circuit at time $t$ (in seconds).

*Hint: The voltage drop ${V}_{C}$ across the capacitor is related to its charge by $q=C{V}_{C},$ where $C$ is the capacitance measured in Farads.*

activity_context.topic_title: Modeling Current in RCL Circuits With Second-Order ODEs
